[quote=erene_federation;60919143][b]Erene Federation Emergency Meeting: January 9th, 2167.[/b]

[b]Briefing:[/b]
[i]"This emergency meeting has been called by the Federation High Council, all member states must participate in this monumental decision. The Erene Federation is experiencing its biggest crisis since the start of the Marisalbic War, one which threatens the continuation of our great alliance. It has come to the attention of the High Council that multiple colonies have openly rebelled against the Federation and are threatening military action against Erene.

On the 7th of January, Zytan Hoffmann, the elected representative of the Korrin Local Authority, proclaimed independence from the Federation as the Jovian Republic of Korrin and placed himself as its first Chancellor, arresting all elements of the Federation on the moon before we could react. This was followed by the illegal independence of Ilynis and then Zeonia, which have cut all communications with the Federation and failed to deliver upon their resource obligations.

Military sources warn that an attack from beyond the Belt of Tears is likely imminent, and more colonies may choose to declare independence."
[/i]
[b]Message from the High Council:[/b]
[i]"The Federation High Council advises an immediate mobilisation and operation to pacify and reclaim the rouge colonies. These colonies are abundant in resources, and the Federation has lost significant access to materials important for our survival. Should the Federation allow these traitors to rule, they may launch an attack on Erene to secure our food sources, and our capacity to grow will be severely limited. These colonies also contain valuable technology which, should they develop them further, may seal the fate of the Federation for good. As such, the High Council calls for an attack against the breakaways. However, the decision is up to the member states. Together as One."[/i]

[Member states of the Erene Federation, make your decisions; either to make peace with the breakaways, initiate an offensive, or another course of action that you may state here.]

[/quote]
